question: State the area and climate described for Aruba; name the countries bordering Andorra.

claims.subject: Aruba
claims.text: Aruba has an area of 179 square kilometres (69.1 sq mi) and has a dry climate with an arid xeric landscape.

references.label: P1.1
references.text: Aruba,[a] officially the Country of Aruba,[b] is an island constituent country within the Kingdom of the Netherlands, in the southern Caribbean Sea 29 kilometres (18 mi) north of the Venezuelan peninsula of Paraguaná and 80 kilometres (50 mi) north-west of Curaçao.[6][7] In 1986, Aruba became a constituent country within the Kingdom of the Netherlands and acquired the official name.

references.label: P2.1
references.text: Aruba has an area of 179 square kilometres (69.1 sq mi), and measures 32 kilometres (20 mi) in length from its north-western to its south-eastern end and is 10 kilometres (6 mi) across at its widest point.[6] Aruba is geologically located in South America, lying on the South American continental shelf.[7] Alongside Bonaire and Curaçao, Aruba forms part of an island group referred to as the ABC islands.

references.label: P2.3
references.text: In contrast to much of the Caribbean, which experiences humid tropical climates, Aruba has a dry climate with an arid xeric landscape.[6][8] The relatively warm and sunny weather persists throughout the year.

claims.subject: Andorra
claims.text: Andorra is bordered by France to the north and Spain to the south.

references.label: P4.1
references.text: Andorra,[c] officially the Principality of Andorra,[d][15] is a landlocked country on the Iberian Peninsula, in the eastern Pyrenees in southwestern Europe, bordered by France to the north and Spain to the south.

references.label: P4.2
references.text: Believed to have been created by Charlemagne, Andorra was ruled by the count of Urgell until 988, when it was transferred to the Diocese of Urgell.

references.label: P4.3
references.text: Andorra was formed as a polity by a charter in 1278, being a lordship within the Principality of Catalonia until 1715.

references.label: P4.4
references.text: It is currently headed by two co-princes: the Bishop of Urgell in Catalonia, Spain, and the president of France.

references.label: P4.5
references.text: Its capital and largest city is Andorra la Vella.

Aruba has an area of 179 square kilometres (69.1 sq mi) and has a dry climate with an arid xeric landscape. [1]
Andorra is bordered by France to the north and Spain to the south. [2]
